say:0:1011310001:0.text: Are the prosthetics you gave me earlier made from these quickvines?
say:0:1011310001:0.source_cn: 你之前给我的义肢……也是用这种藤蔓做的？

say:1:1011310002:0.text: That's right! Quickvines are sturdy and quick to grow. They can be found almost everywhere in the forest.
say:1:1011310002:0.source_cn: 是啊！速生藤又坚韧，长得又快，丛林里经常能见到。

say:2:1011310003:0.text: Now that we've got all the necessary materials, let's head back to the crafting table and start the work!
say:2:1011310003:0.source_cn: 这样原料就齐全了，现在回制作台，开始精加工！
